meta.title: PuntPoints and rewards | Puntr
meta.description: Earn PuntPoints for activity and invites, and redeem them for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks. No cash.
meta.ogDescription: PuntPoints reward activity, never results. No cash value.

title: PuntPoints and rewards
subtitle: A loyalty scheme for active members. Points reward activity, never results.

soon.title: PuntPoints are on their way
soon.body: You will earn points for confirming your email, posting picks and inviting friends, and redeem them for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks. We switch them on once the rules are final. There is no cash value and points can never be bought.

signIn.body: Sign in to see your balance, invite friends and redeem rewards.

confirm.title: Confirm your email to earn and redeem points.
confirm.body: Points and rewards are for members with a confirmed email address.

earn.title: How to earn
earn.body: Points come from activity, never from winning, and never from spending.

rule.referral_referrer: A friend you invited posts a first pick

catalogue.title: Rewards
catalogue.empty: No rewards are available right now. Check back soon.
catalogue.soon: Rewards open once our sponsors confirm them. Your points keep building in the meantime.
catalogue.error: Couldn't load rewards. Please try again.

redeem.done: Redeemed. We will send your reward shortly if it is not ready yet.

error.not_eligible: You need a confirmed email, to be 18 or older and not on a break to redeem this.
error.daily_limit: You've reached today's redemption limit. Try again tomorrow.
error.insufficient_points: You don't have enough points for that.
error.generic: We couldn't redeem that. Please try again.

redemptions.title: Your redemptions
redemptions.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it.

status.requested: Waiting for us to send it

rules.note: PuntPoints have no cash value, cannot be bought, exchanged for money or transferred, and never change rankings or the leaderboard. We may reverse points earned through fraud or abuse. Rewards are provided by our partners and subject to their terms.
